compressed_sources: Use gzip -dc file.py.gz > file.py in one clean directory; decompress results.json.gz and evidence.json.gz analogously; then run unittest. The code and tests are stored compressed as exact original UTF-8 bytes (gzip mtime zero).
caveat: The full local research note/evidence set is also in the downloadable ZIP; summarized research note and independently sourced evidence mapping are in this commit. No original-paper novelty claimed.
